title: A Rivergate for the Landfall
premise: Isandro Coldharbour, a storm chaser drowning in debt to the Vane Syndicate, is hired to track a vanished government survey team in the Landfall Range — but the team wasn't lost, they were erased, and the compass Isandro carries belonged to one of them. Racing the calving season, she gathers a makeshift crew of outcasts: a disgraced cartographer, a syndicate defector, and the survey leader's stubborn daughter. Together they uncover a land-grant fraud the government will kill to bury, and Isandro must choose between paying her debt with the evidence or burning her debt — and her old life — by exposing it. In the end, the crew delivers the truth over the pass as the glacier closes behind them, finding in each other the family none of them had, and a justice no court could grant.
about_author: Tamsin Zhou is a former field researcher who traded lab notebooks for fiction after a season mapping glacier melt in the northern ranges. She writes adventure stories about people who belong to landscapes more than to institutions.

chapters.title: The Weight of Owed Things
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. A storm-chasing job goes sideways and her debt to the Vane Syndicate deepens; a syndicate collector offers her an out: find the vanished Landfall survey team. She inherits their abandoned basecamp gear and a compass engraved with a name she doesn't recognize. Beat: reluctant commitment, dread beneath bravado.

chapters.title: Gear With No Tracks
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV at the abandoned survey camp. Supplies intact, tents zipped, no footprints leading out — only a government seal freshly painted over. She realizes the team didn't wander off; they were taken or hid. The compass needle spins wildly near the ridge. Beat: unease curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Confession
chapters.summary: Alternating POV: Isandro and Odile Ferrant, a disgraced mapmaker arrested for falsifying the very survey charts. Odile claims her maps were doctored to hide a valley — and the survey team found it. She bargains her freedom for a place on Isandro's crossing. Beat: wary alliance, first thread of the conspiracy.

chapters.title: Snowmelt and Small Treasons
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV on the trail. The crew assembles: Odile, Rennick (a syndicate defector sent to watch Isandro), and Wren Ashvale, the survey leader's daughter, who forces her way aboard. Trust is thin; Rennick secretly reports their position. Beat: found-family friction, the crew takes shape against the clock.

chapters.title: What the Glacier Keeps
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Ice retreat reveals the survey team's cache — and Wren's father's journal describing a fertile valley the government erased from every map to sell the land to the Syndicate. The compass points to a second cache across the calving fields. Beat: grief and purpose fused; the stakes become personal and moral.

chapters.title: The Collector's Patience
chapters.summary: Rennick's POV, then Isandro's. The Syndicate's enforcer catches them at the tree line; Rennick's betrayal is exposed, but he turns his gun on his own handlers instead, buying the crew an escape at the cost of his supplies. Isandro learns her debt was a leash, not a ledger. Beat: betrayal, sacrifice, the crew bound by shared risk.

chapters.title: Crossing Before the Calving
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The race across the ice fields as the season's first calvings thunder behind them. Odile's true maps guide them through a crevasse maze no official chart shows, and Isandro finally trusts her fully. Beat: hard-won trust; the landscape itself becomes both enemy and witness.

chapters.title: The Valley That Isn't There
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. They find the second cache and the surviving survey member, half-mad, guarding proof: sealed land-grant documents naming the Syndicate's buyers inside the government. But the pass ahead is closing, and a Syndicate party is climbing toward them. Beat: triumph shadowed by siege; the choice crystallizes.

chapters.title: A Rivergate for the Landfall
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV at the climax. At the narrow rivergate pass, the crew holds the Syndicate off as the glacier calves, flooding the route behind them — evidence secured, pursuers stranded. Isandro broadcasts the documents to every relay station in the range. Beat: sacrifice of the old life, justice delivered outside any courtroom.

chapters.title: Debt Forgiven, Compass True
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV, epilogue. The scandal breaks; the valley's existence is acknowledged and its people — the survey team's survivors and the families they'd sheltered — granted standing. Isandro's debt dies with the Syndicate's charter. The compass, it turns out, was her father's. Beat: belonging earned, home chosen, the crew staying together by choice.
